fetch_rule: FETCH-59 (reports/round-59/rowcheck.py docstring), declared before data and never relaxed after: one fetch per URL per run, reused by every leg; a row's source cell lists its live URL first and may list one Wayback capture of the same page (web.archive.org/web/<14 digits>id_/<live URL>); a URL whose fetch raises an error (no response, TLS, timeout, any HTTP error after the locator's three attempts on 429/5xx/508) is skipped and never passes; BOILER's root falls back once to the capture root at the row's capture timestamp (2026 when none is listed). A row with no locating URL, or with both roots failing, fails. Unreachable pages are therefore treated as: live failure -> listed capture; no capture or capture failure -> FAIL.
